blurb: Guests can explore Moab's iconic trails such as Hell's Revenge, Fins & Things, Poison Spider Mesa, Catacomb Caves, and Hurrah Pass on guided side-by-side UTV adventures or self-drive rentals. Tours are designed for all skill levels with expert local guides focusing on safety and fun. Premium Polaris RZR, Kawasaki KRX, and Jeep Wrangler Rubicon vehicles are used for both tours and rentals.
